dct_description_sm: This multi-year project aimed to address the gap in data collection and communication with regards to climate change (impacts and adaptation) in Labrador. The objectives of the first year of the project were: (1) To compile existing knowledge on climate change impacts and potential adaptation measures in Labrador; and (2) to identify priorities in climate change impact and adaptation.   In its second year, the project focused on the monitoring of stressors and the development of adaptive strategies. The goal was to build the adaptive capacity of Nunatsiavut communities and to inform policy-makers on climate change adaptation.
